errors.text: The predicted fracture-morphology shift is reversed: the HPHT-treated material should exhibit distributed or isolated microcracks rather than the elongated, catastrophic interfacial cracks characteristic of the untreated baseline.

The falsification logic is inverted. Failure of conventional thermomechanical treatments to reproduce hierarchical coherence or GND homogenization supports the claimed specificity of HPHT rather than falsifying it.
